svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 04 · Irvine · 07/12 Ring Mall (Common)
svg.desc: The walkway that loops the park. Go the long way around and you still get where you meant to go. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
